requested_changes.body:
Recording model-generated images in context is a feature we'll need to support if we want Gemini 3 Pro image generation to work properly.

Currently, the `07n-interruptible-gemini-image` example works because the model always also generates some text after generating an image. If you switch the model to "gemini-3-pro-image-preview", though, you'll see that the example stops working after the first time the model generates an image, since it doesn't also generate text. The response containing the image is never recorded to context, so the model doesn't know it's already done the work. Every future turn of the conversation just causes the model to generate a new image.

Currently, the `07n-interruptible-gemini-image` example works because the model always also generates some text after generating an image. The response containing the image is never recorded to context, so the model doesn't know it's already done the work. Every future turn of the conversation just causes the model to generate a new image.
